47 leads imported in 9 minutes.
No copy-paste. No spreadsheet. One click.

That's LinkedNav's Chrome extension running on a Sales Navigator search.

Old way:

→ Switch to your CRM
→ Copy name, title, company, profile URL
→ Paste it in manually
→ Repeat that 47 times

New way with LinkedNav:
→ Open any LinkedIn search or post
→ Hit the LinkedNav extension
→ Choose how many pages to pull
→ Every lead lands in your campaign instantly

It works on:
→ Sales Navigator searches
→ People who liked or commented on a post
→ LinkedIn event attendees
→ Employees at a specific company

About 2 hours back in your week, per list built.
Zero manual entries.

Comment "outreach hack" 👇 and I'll send you the direct download link.

LINKEDIN + EMAIL + PHONE.
All from one platform. On full AUTOPILOT.

Here's exactly how it works inside LinkedNav.

Step 3: Email follow-up fires automatically
→ Goes out 3 days post-connection
→ References the LinkedIn touchpoint so it doesn't feel random

Step 4: Phone enrichment for your best leads
→ Verified mobile for the highest-intent contacts only
→ You call in with full context already loaded

One platform.

GAME OVER for spray-and-pray LinkedIn outreach.

Most LinkedIn teams still reach out 1 of 2 ways:

They think targeting is about filtering by job title.

It's not.

LinkedNav's Signal Agent does something completely different.

Every day it:

→ Captures every person who engaged with them
→ Ranks each one by intent level
→ Automatically drops them into your campaign

These aren't cold leads you're reaching out to.
These are people already raising their hand in public.

Accept rates: 2-3x higher.
Reply rates: 3-5x higher.
Time prospecting: down to zero.

No more guessing who's ready.

No more wasted weeks on dead lists.
